run_codegen_helloworld: run the protoc code generator to produce Python and gRPC stubs from helloworld.proto
run_codegen_route_guide: run the protoc code generator to produce Python and gRPC stubs from route_guide.proto
run_codegen_all: run the protoc code generator to produce Python and gRPC stubs for all proto files in the multiplex example
review_protoc_invocation: review the protoc.main invocation arguments for include path and output directory configuration
refactor_codegen_paths: refactor the run_codegen script to parameterize proto file paths and output directories
